title: Analysis-aware interface coarsening for elliptic problems driven by an equilibrated flux estimator
summary: We propose an a posteriori error estimator that relies on an equilibrated flux reconstruction to enable analysis-aware interface coarsening decisions in elliptic interface problems. Interface coarsening consists of simplifying an internal interface that separates regions characterized by different physical properties in order to facilitate the meshing process and reduce the total number of degrees of freedom.
